text:
Ravi (Partnerships): Heads up — vendor NimbusEdge listing failed PO ingestion for APAC marketplaces. Procurement says EDI rejected due to tax code mismatch + export-control flag.
Lena (Marketplace Ops): I see the ingest error: `PO rejected: TAX_CODE_INVALID (line_items[0].tax_code=0000)` and `EXPORT_RESTRICTION: requires_end_user_declaration`. Portal link: https://portal.redwood.example/marketplace/nimbusedge/orders/98765
Tom (Finance): That tax code 0000 is the placeholder. We need vendor to send amended PO with correct VAT/tax code for region. Finance can't accept until corrected, and we also need export clearance for certain GPU SKUs.
Priya (Legal): Which SKU is triggering export-control? If it's AVX-accelerated edge device SKU: `nx-edge-gpu-4`, requires end-user attestation and possibly an export license depending on destination country. We need the vendor to supply completed EUD (end user declaration).
Diego (Sales): Vendor claims they've sent the EUD during onboarding but portal doesn't show it. They emailed a PDF but maybe it was attached to the wrong marketplace account. Can partnerships verify asset mapping?
Ravi (Partnerships): I've asked vendor for re-submit. They're pushing for a PO ASAP — partner execs want this live by EOD for co-marketing. We should avoid white-labeling risk.
Lena (Marketplace Ops): Quick mitigation: we can accept a provisional manifest mapping and hold fulfillment until EUD is validated. Ops policy requires documented attestation + record in ticketing. I can open ticket MKT-4521 to log.
deploy-bot: Ticket created MKT-4521 by Lena (Marketplace Ops) — https://internal.redwood.example/tickets/MKT-4521
Tom (Finance): If we accept provisional mapping, Finance will issue a capped provisional PO #PO-100921 limited to evaluating orders (max $8k) and mark it `hold: export_verification`. No payment until EUD is cleared.
Priya (Legal): Legal will accept vendor-provided EUD PDF + business email header as interim evidence but must verify signatory is authorized. If vendor cannot provide EUD within 48h we must pause listing. Also need to flag the vendor record with `requires_export_review`.
Diego (Sales): Can Partnerships help chase the vendor's authorized signer? I can provide the partner exec contact. Also need to ensure co-marketing won't go live accidentally.
Ravi (Partnerships): I'll escalate to partner ops now and get the signer contact. Sending message to partner exec Raj now.
Ravi (Partnerships): Sent to partner: "Raj — quick ask: please resend EUD for nx-edge-gpu-4 to partnerships@redwood.example and include signer name + title. We need this to clear tax/export hold."
Lena (Marketplace Ops): Added vendor tag `requires_export_review` and `tax_code_pending`. Also added `onboard_status: hold`.
Tom (Finance): Generated provisional PO PO-100921 and emailed vendor finance team with note: "Provisional acceptance pending EUD and corrected tax code. Payment release upon verification."
Priya (Legal): Once we have EUD I'll cross-check signatory against corporate filings. If clean, legal will clear within same business day.
Diego (Sales): Noted. I'll pause the co-marketing assets and inform partner marketing. :no_entry_sign:
Ravi (Partnerships): Update: Raj replied with EUD attached and sender header. Uploading to ticket MKT-4521 and vendor record.
Lena (Marketplace Ops): Uploaded EUD: https://portal.redwood.example/storage/nimbusedge/eud_2026-03-21.pdf — marking for review.
deploy-bot: MKT-4521 updated: EUD attached by Ravi (Partnerships)
Priya (Legal): Reviewed attestation and signer matches corporate registry. Legal clears export attestation. Post clearing note in ticket.
Tom (Finance): Finance confirms corrected tax code received (`VAT-APAC-220`) and updated backend. Releasing hold: converting PO-100921 provisional to normal flow pending final portal ingestion.
Lena (Marketplace Ops): Re-ingesting PO now. Ingest success: `order 98765 accepted`. Removing `requires_export_review` tag.
Diego (Sales): Great — sales notified partner that listing can proceed. Re-scheduling co-marketing for next week.
Ravi (Partnerships): Closing actions: MKT-4521 (ops ticket) closed, PO-100921 converted, EUD stored, vendor tags cleaned. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Legal): I'll keep a short note in the contract log referencing MKT-4521 for audit.
Tom (Finance): All good from Finance. Closing thread.
